analysis: The code snippet calls XMLInputFactory.newInstance() without any precondition checks. The javadoc declares that FactoryConfigurationError may be thrown if the factory cannot be loaded. FactoryConfigurationError is a subclass of Error, not Exception, so it is not caught by the catch (Exception e) block. No validation or handling is in place to avoid this error. Therefore, the throwing condition is not avoided.
remark: FactoryConfigurationError is thrown when the XMLInputFactory implementation cannot be loaded, typically due to a missing or misconfigured service provider. The code does not check for or handle this error, so it will propagate to the caller.
